# DetsPlus v2.4.4 - Table of Contents

> Pure Elixir disk backed key-value store.

## Modules

- [DetsPlus](https://dets-plus.hexdocs.pm/DetsPlus.md): DetsPlus persistent tuple/struct/map storage.
- [DetsPlus.HashLRU](https://dets-plus.hexdocs.pm/DetsPlus.HashLRU.md): DetsPlus.HashLRU Hash based Least-Recently-Used cache based on DetsPlus persistent storage.
- [DetsPlus.LRU](https://dets-plus.hexdocs.pm/DetsPlus.LRU.md): DetsPlus.LRU Least-Recently-Used cache based on DetsPlus persistent storage.
- [KrakenDB](https://dets-plus.hexdocs.pm/KrakenDB.md): Alpha version of a sharded DetsPlus
